pages.title: Overview
pages.text:
A Nether-themed melee weapon. Base damage 8, attack speed 2.0.

Any holder — player or doll — ignites the target for 4s on hit (stacks with Fire Aspect; doubled to 16s when a Nether doll wields it).

Owner (player) perks
• Fire Resistance while held (main hand or offhand), plus 6 golden hearts (12 absorption, consumed before your own HP, fades when put down)
• Charge right-click for 1s to summon a flying sword

Dolls have their own innate fire-resistance system (see the Nether doll) and don't gain these player passives.

pages.title: Flying Nether Sword
pages.text:
• Hovers behind the player
• Auto-attacks the nearest hostile mob within 16 blocks
• Dive-bomb: 8 damage + ignite for 8s
• Only one active at a time; summoning again replaces the old one

While a Nether doll holds this sword, its burn durations are all doubled: melee 16s, flame arrow 16s, fireball 10s.
